summary: This Form 8-K reports an unregistered sale of 2,615,087 common shares by Fortress Credit Realty Income Trust for gross proceeds of approximately $52.4 million, based on June 30, 2026 NAV per share. It also declares routine monthly distributions per class, payable in cash or reinvested through the distribution reinvestment plan. The transaction is an ordinary continuous offering under exemptions, not a special situation. No M&A event, tender offer, or restructuring is present. What to watch would be continued NAV stability and distribution coverage, but no risk-arb angle applies as this is routine capital raising.
